Sample Protocol

Sample Protocol is a decentralised exchange on Ethereum and Arbitrum.

The router contract lives at 0xC2EdaD668740f1aA35E4D8f227fB8E17dcA888Cd on Ethereum Mainnet.

Trading fee: 0.3% per swap, of which 0.05% goes to the treasury.

Audited by CertiK in 2025.
